presets.name: Flocks
presets.description: Neighbours align and gather into moving family groups.

presets.name: Pursuit
presets.description: Each family chases one colour and flees another. Chasing does not eat particles.

presets.name: Colonies
presets.description: Strong family attraction and cross-family repulsion form separate clusters.
